title: Function-boundary correspondence lemma refine_sync for the BilbyFs sync operation
intent: refine_sync states, at the boundary of the generated fsop_sync program, that the abstract afs_sync and the concrete fsop_sync_fs correspond under rsync_res. Its proof peels the generated monadic program with the generic cogent_corres_* rules and closes each remaining obligation with a named helper lemma, so the parent system-call refinement can cite refine_sync instead of unfolding fsop_sync's generated code.

parent.name: refine_sync
parent.statement:
lemma refine_sync:
notes length_drop[simp del]
assumes rel:"afs_fsop_rel afs fs_st"
shows
  "\<And>ex. cogent_corres rsync_res
         (afs_sync afs) (fsop_sync_fs (FsopFsP.make ex fs_st))"

children.name: fold_comp
children.statement:
lemma fold_comp[rule_format]:
  "xs = ys @ zs \<longrightarrow> fold f xs accu = (fold f zs (fold f ys accu))"
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: folding over a list equals folding zs after folding ys when the list is ys @ zs

children.name: corres_sync_err
children.statement:
lemma corres_sync_err:
"afs_fsop_rel afs fs_st \<Longrightarrow>
 cogent_corres rsync_res (return (afs, R.Error e)) (\<lparr>FsopFsP.ex\<^sub>f = ex, fs_st\<^sub>f = fs_st\<rparr>, R.Error e)"
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the sync error branch corresponds: the returned Error e relates to the concrete Error e

children.name: length_updates_eqD
children.statement:
lemma length_updates_eqD:
 "afs_fsop_rel afs fs_st \<Longrightarrow>
 length (\<alpha>_updates (FsState.ostore_st\<^sub>f fs_st)) = length (a_medium_updates afs)"
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: under afs_fsop_rel, the ostore update list and the abstract medium updates have equal length

children.name: afs_fsop_match_updates
children.statement:
lemma afs_fsop_match_updates:
 "afs_fsop_match (fold id xs' a) (fold id ys' c) \<Longrightarrow> xs' = xs \<Longrightarrow> ys' = ys \<Longrightarrow>
  afs_fsop_match (fold id xs a) (fold id ys c)"
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: afs_fsop_match of two folds is preserved when the folded lists are respectively equal

children.closed_by: apply (simp add: updated_afs_def); apply (simp add: afs_inv_steps_def); apply (erule_tac x="length (a_medium_updates afs)" in allE); apply (fastforce simp add: a_afs_updated_def); done

applicability.goal_shape: a correspondence goal cogent_corres R (abstract-op args) (generated-concrete-op args) where the concrete side is a generated monadic program (here fsop_sync_fs) and the abstract side is a thin wrapper (here afs_sync); the statement is generic over the exception via the meta-universal quantifier (⋀ ex)
applicability.use_when: the concrete side is a generated program whose code clients must not unfold; the boundary lemma can be proven once by structure-directed peeling with generic correspondence rules, and each leaf obligation is naturally a self-contained named lemma
applicability.avoid_when: the generated program contains a monadic combinator with no matching correspondence rule (the peeling stalls); or the leaf obligations are not independent (the helpers here each close by one automated tactic, so a client with intertwined obligations would not split this cleanly)

consequences: The glue depends on the exact shape of the generated program: each cogent_corres_conc_let_exec peels one let, so a change in the Cogent code generator's output shape breaks the peeling sequence and must be re-fitted. The statement is kept generic over the exception via the meta-universal quantifier (⋀ ex), so a client instantiates it; the error branch and the update-list arithmetic are separate obligations discharged by corres_sync_err, length_updates_eqD, afs_fsop_match_updates and fold_comp rather than by the correspondence rules. Failure modes: a new monadic combinator in the generated code without a matching cogent_corres_* rule stalls the glue; the helper updates_take_eq (FsopSyncR.thy 45-51) is declared but never used by refine_sync, showing the boundary of what the glue actually needs.
